author: iEJH
content: Result: M5 UI scaffolding complete. 6 commits, 1704 lines added. Zustand store with 23 Layer 1 params across 5 groups + 7 presets. Tabbed ControlPanel with slider/toggle/number controls, preset selector, 14-layer data toggle, export UI. IndexedDB persistence via idb (planet/preset CRUD + snapshot roundtrip). PNG export in 4 projections (equirectangular/Mercator/Robinson/orthographic), SVG export, GeoJSON + TopoJSON export. VTT exports deferred per REQ-14. All 273 tests pass, TypeScript clean.
